title: pdf_prebake regen docs say pass priv dir as CLI arg; main() only reads RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR env var and ignores argv
evidence:
+//// Regenerate (after fixture craft changes):
+////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv
+////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative
+////    to the server package root.)
...
+  let priv_dir = case envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") {
+    Ok(dir) -> dir
+    Error(_) -> "priv"
  }
detail: Header documents a positional arg that main() never reads; following the documented command silently writes to ./priv/static/demo instead of server/priv. The env-var comment further down contradicts the header.
recommended_fix: Make the header the env-var form (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=... gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake) or actually parse argv; delete one of the two contradicting instructions.

title: demo_requests_are_intercepted_test claims the Loading transition proves demo interception, but the real api path sets Loading too
evidence:
+/// The demo never touches the real api modules: every demo request message
+/// is intercepted by demo_update (this test asserts the request handlers do
+/// NOT fall through to update_inner's real api dispatch — the Loading state
+/// change proves the demo branch ran).
detail: If demo_update stopped intercepting, the real update_inner arm would run with the mock authed landlord and also set vacancies/notifications to Loading before firing its (opaque) effect. The test passes either way; it pins nothing about interception.
recommended_fix: Drop the claim from the docstring and rely on the CI lint, or assert something only the demo branch produces (e.g. a demo-specific effect or store transition).

title: Manifest matcher counts any capitalized constructor line in handle bodies as 'handled', not just case patterns
evidence:
+            m = re.match(r"^([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+)(\(| ->| \||$)", stripped)
+            if m:
+                handled.add(m.group(1))
detail: Any stripped line inside the case starting with a capitalized identifier matches — including message constructors the demo build dispatches (per the design, demo_update constructs response/request Msgs). A DEMO_INTERCEPTED entry constructed-but-not-matched satisfies the manifest.
recommended_fix: Only record identifiers whose line sits at the case-arm indent depth for the outer case, or require the `->` arm-arrow form; constructor calls in bodies must not count.

title: EXEMPT_ARMS exempts arms the comment says are demo-guarded — so removing those guards keeps the lint green
evidence:
+# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode
+# (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are
+# demo-guarded at the top of their handlers).
+EXEMPT_ARMS = {
detail: If ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are demo-guarded, the arm-bounded guard scan would pass them anyway; listing them in EXEMPT_ARMS instead means a future guard deletion is silently masked. The comment and the mechanism contradict.
recommended_fix: Remove ApiReturnedSession/ApiReturnedPolicyRefresh from EXEMPT_ARMS and let the guard scan verify the guards the comment describes; keep only genuinely unreachable arms.

title: Fetch exemption whitelists the whole demo_api.gleam file, not just the documented download function
detail: The comment limits the permitted fetch to demo_api.download, but the grep excludes the entire module — any future gleam/fetch use anywhere in demo_api.gleam passes silently.
recommended_fix: Grep for fetch call sites within demo_api.gleam and assert they fall inside the download function, or split download into its own module and whitelist that.

title: demo_analytics FFI accepts props_json but the only Gleam entry point always sends "{}" — FFI header promises props that never arrive
detail: capture_event is the sole pub function and hardcodes empty props, so the props_json parameter and the FFI comment about carrying surface names and fixture ids describe capability nothing uses.
recommended_fix: Either add a capture_event_with_props(event, props) used by vacancy/application/download events, or drop the param and correct the FFI header comment.

title: Declan fixture: household 650000 contradicts the stated invariant (primary 350000, no co-applicants; guarantor is 310000, not 300000)
evidence:
+// varied statuses, believable Irish stories. `household_monthly_income_cents`
+// equals primary income + income sources + co-applicants so the leaderboard
+// and detail page add up without re-summing.
...
+const app_declan_json = "{\"id\":\"a-declan\",...\"monthly_income_cents\":350000,...\"guarantor_monthly_income_cents\":310000,...\"household_monthly_income_cents\":650000,\"co_applicant_count\":0}"
detail: With co_applicant_count 0 and no income sources, the header invariant makes household 350000. Even if the guarantor counted, 350000+310000=660000, not 650000. The 'adds up' promise is false for this row.
recommended_fix: Set household_monthly_income_cents to 350000 (or add an income source explaining the delta) so the fixture satisfies its own documented invariant.

title: Maples/Harbour fixtures: created_at + validity_days does not equal closes_at (Sunningdale's does)
detail: Maples: 2026-07-20 + 14d = 2026-08-03, not 2026-08-25 (36d). Harbour: 2026-08-02 + 21d = 2026-08-23, not 2026-09-02 (31d). Sunningdale is internally consistent. A landlord doing the math sees fake data that doesn't add up.
recommended_fix: Align closes_at to created_at + validity_days for both fixtures (or adjust validity_days), matching the Sunningdale row.

title: Committed design mock contradicts the shipped fixtures: 'Scored Applications 7' vs test-pinned 8, 'Two PDFs baked' vs eight PDFs, 'Grace Kelly' vs Gráinne Foley
evidence:
+

Scored Applications

7

+ stats.scored_applications |> should.equal(8) +

Two PDFs baked once through the real Typst pipeline + Grace Kelly + applicant_name: "Gráinne Foley",
detail: Same PR ships a mock claiming 'what you approve is what ships' while its stats (7 vs 8 scored, '6 analysed'), applicant name, and PDF count (two vs eight report-a-*.pdf files) all disagree with the implementation.
recommended_fix: Update the mock's numbers, names, and PDF count to the shipped fixtures, or annotate it as superseded pre-implementation design.

title: Sunningdale is labelled 'archived' in comments and tests, but its JSON carries status "draft" and no archived marker
evidence:
+//   v-sunningdale Sunningdale, Cork          archived        — proves the
+//                 Archived view + one-click restore.
...
+const vacancy_sunningdale_json = "{...\"status\":\"draft\",\"validity_days\":30,...\"closes_at\":\"2026-07-15T23:59:00Z\"}"
...
+  list.length(demo_store.archived(store)) |> should.equal(1)
detail: The fixture JSON has no archived_at-style field and status is "draft", yet the conformance test expects it in archived(). Whatever puts it there (hidden store logic, past closes_at) is invisible and looks like a mislabeled draft.
recommended_fix: Make the archived membership explicit in the fixture (an archived flag/field if the type has one) or document the derivation where the vacancy is seeded.

title: Grace's baked PDF flag 'Income covers only 58% of the rent requirement' fails arithmetic: 2400/2450 is ~98%
evidence:
+      flags: "[{\"label\":\"Previous tenancy ended with a possession order\",\"severity\":\"red\",\"category\":\"red_flag_detection\"},{\"label\":\"Income covers only 58% of the rent requirement\",\"severity\":\"red\",\"category\":\"income_affordability\"},{\"label\":\"CCJ on file\",\"severity\":\"red\",\"category\":\"red_flag_detection\"}]",
...
+      240_000,
+      240_000,
...
+      monthly_rent_cents: 245_000,
detail: Income €2,400 vs rent €2,450 covers ~98% of the rent, and ~39% of a 2.5x requirement — no reading yields 58%. Every other payload's number checks out (Aoife 2.9x, Sara 72%); this one is baked into a public marketing PDF.
recommended_fix: Recompute the figure (e.g. 'Rent exceeds 100% of stated income') or lower Grace's fixture income so the 58% claim holds.

title: clear_demo_state was inserted between policy_reaccept_required's doc comment and its function — the whole policy doc now attaches to clear_demo_state
detail: Contiguous /// lines merge into one doc block: the policy-versioning prose now documents clear_demo_state, and policy_reaccept_required loses its doc comment entirely.
recommended_fix: Move clear_demo_state (with its own doc) above the start of policy_reaccept_required's doc comment, not between the comment and its function.

title: lint scope-name parsing and guard detection are textual: dotted arm lines misparse, and a comment mentioning model.demo_mode satisfies the guard
evidence:
+            arm = lines[j].strip().split("(")[0].split(".")[-1]
...
+        if "model.demo_mode" in line or "updated_model.demo_mode" in line:
+            if depth <= call_depth:
+                return True
detail: An arm line like `Msg -> case model.demo_mode {` parses scope as 'demo_mode' (split on '.'), disabling manifest/exemption matching; and any comment containing 'model.demo_mode' at shallow depth satisfies the guard for a genuinely unguarded call.
recommended_fix: Match 'case ... demo_mode' with a regex that excludes comment lines, and extract the arm name before any '->' rather than splitting on dots.

title: int_to_string is a pointless one-line wrapper around int.to_string
detail: Wrapper adds an indirection with zero behavior; gleam/int is already imported and used nowhere else but through this alias.
recommended_fix: Call int.to_string directly at the three call sites and delete the wrapper.

title: seed_error_from_result discards the DecodeError, so the drift guard can't say which fixture/field rotted
detail: The module's stated purpose is failing loudly on API drift, but the mapped error drops the decode path entirely — a red conformance run won't identify which of the nine blobs or which field drifted.
recommended_fix: Include string.inspect(error) (and ideally the fixture name) in the SeedError message.

title: demo_create_vacancy_mutates_store_test binds 'before' only to discard it
evidence:
+  let before = should_be_some_store(m.demo_store)
...
+  created.days_remaining |> should.equal(21)
+  let _ = before
detail: Fetching the pre-mutation store and immediately discarding it is dead weight; either assert the pre-count (2) from it or delete the binding.
recommended_fix: Assert demo_store.dashboard(before) count == 2 to make the before/after comparison real, or drop the binding.
